summary: Implemented and committed a typed preset-or-project filter for Dockside. The existing filter menu now lists live project groups, the trigger displays the selected project, the inbox scopes its complete hierarchy by project ID, All restores the existing views, and a vanished project resets only after BB reports ready data. Added behavioral and UI contract coverage plus README guidance. Synced against origin/main with no conflicts. Verification remains pending.

state.request: Add a Dockside sidebar filter for the bbplugins project/environment, matching Cursor-style project filtering and the grouped sidebar shown in the supplied screenshots. Preserve existing status and inactivity filters. The filter must narrow visible thread groups to the selected project, expose the active selection in the filter control, and include behavioral tests for filtering and UI contract coverage.
